title: First repeated ticket
description:
A support queue should never contain the same ticket ID twice, but a sync bug is creating repeats.

Write `first_repeat(ticket_ids)` that returns the first ID whose **second** occurrence comes earliest in the list. Return `None` if every ID is unique.

**Example**

```
first_repeat(["T1", "T2", "T3", "T2", "T1"])
# "T2"   (T2 repeats at index 3, T1 not until index 4)
```
hints: Walk the list once and remember what you have seen.
A `set` gives you O(1) membership checks, where a list would make this O(n²).
